review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Department: IT & Innovation Location: Heathrow Office Description Menzies is an equal opportunities employer which means that we recruit, employ, train, pay, and promote regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability or age. We are building a first-class team and, to do so, we know that we need a diverse mix of talented people doing their best work. If you’re ready to make an impact, lead with purpose, and work in a place where your voice truly matters, keep reading! We have a great opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team and can be based from any of our Menzies offices . The purpose of this role is to lead the development and operation of Menzies’ GCP data warehouse, creating a trusted, secure and accessible data foundation that enables insightful reporting, automation and AI, and supports smarter decision-making across the firm. Why Menzies? At Menzies, Our Culture Is Our Cornerstone. We Blend Technical Excellence With Genuine Care For Our People And Clients. With Over 1100 Colleagues In The UK, We’ve Built a Culture Based On Shared Values And Mutual Respect. Here’s Why You’ll Love Working With Us 🌟 People First : Our work-life balance isn’t just talk. From agile working to generous leave, we create space for what matters to you and this is why we were recognised as one of the Best Places to Work 2024, 2025 and now also 2026 🌟 Work with Inspiring Clients : You’ll be working with a range of clients so no two days will be the same. 🌟 Collaborate Across The Firm : Working with various people across the firm to raise the profile of Menzies Academy 🌟 Innovate with Purpose : We’re always looking for better ways to work—leveraging tech, simplifying complexities, and delivering value. 🌟 Empathy at Our Core : We don’t just serve our clients; we build trusted relationships that stand the test of time. Key Responsibilities Here’s what you’ll be doing: Lead the design and delivery of scalable, resilient data pipelines into BigQuery, integrating data from a wide range of internal systems, APIs, databases, files, webhooks and event streams. Shape the engineering approach across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), working with technologies including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Datastream and Cloud Composer/Airflow, alongside Terraform and infrastructure-as-code. Set and champion high engineering standards across data modelling, dbt (data build tool) transformations, testing, monitoring, documentation, deployment, version control and cost optimisation. Partner with teams across the firm to turn business needs into scalable, reusable data products, bringing together data from external and internal sources such as Companies House, HMRC, Exchange Online, Active Directory, iManage and Dayshape. Embed security, governance and data quality by design, ensuring appropriate controls around data lineage, access, GDPR compliance, least-privilege security and the handling of sensitive client, HR, payroll and financial information. Provide technical leadership to the wider team, reviewing designs and code, mentoring data engineers and analysts, and helping to strengthen engineering capability across the Innovation Team. Enable data to deliver real business value by working with developers and analysts to make warehouse outputs accessible through Power BI, automation workflows, AI agents and internal applications. Evaluate technology and integration options, making pragmatic build-versus-buy recommendations that balance business value, security, scalability, supportability and cost. Champion data enablement across Menzies, supporting colleagues to confidently access, understand and use data safely and effectively. Help shape the Innovation Team roadmap, prioritising strategic, repeatable platforms and solutions that can deliver value across the firm rather than one-off fixes. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise What We’re Looking For: We’re looking for an experienced and curious data professional who combines strong technical expertise with a practical, people-focused approach. You’ll be comfortable taking ownership, making sound technical decisions and bringing others with you; whether you’re mentoring colleagues, partnering with stakeholders or turning a complex business challenge into a scalable solution. You don’t need to tick every box. We’re interested in people who can bring the right mix of experience, technical capability and ambition to help us continue developing our data and innovation capability. What You’ll Bring Strong hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or data platform roles, typically gained over 5+ years, with experience operating at a senior or leadership level. Advanced SQL and Python skills and experience using them to build reliable, production-ready data solutions. Strong experience with cloud data warehouses, ideally BigQuery, and a good working knowledge of the wider Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem. Experience with modern data engineering tools and practices such as Airflow/Cloud Composer, dbt, Git/GitHub, CI/CD and Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling. A solid understanding of data modelling, dimensional modelling, orchestration, testing, data quality and operational monitoring, with a focus on building solutions that are scalable and maintainable. Experience designing and operating production-grade data pipelines, integrating data from sources such as APIs, databases, flat files, webhooks and message queues. A strong appreciation of data security and governance, including GDPR, role-based access, secrets management and the responsible handling of sensitive information. The ability to take an ambiguous business challenge and turn it into a clear, pragmatic technical solution, balancing immediate needs with longer-term value. Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the confidence to make complex technical concepts accessible to non-technical audiences and influence decisions at different levels. A collaborative leadership style, with a genuine interest in coaching others, sharing knowledge and raising engineering standards across the team. Qualifications & Experience A degree or equivalent experience in computer science, data engineering, software engineering, mathematics, statistics or a related technical discipline would be beneficial. Google Cloud, dbt or other relevant data engineering certifications are also welcomed, although practical experience and demonstrable expertise are just as important to us . Experience within professional services, finance, accounting, legal, tax, audit or another regulated environment would be an advantage, but it isn’t essential. Above all, we’re looking for someone who brings ownership, sound judgement and a delivery mindset . You’ll enjoy solving problems, challenging how things are done and finding better ways of working, while maintaining a strong focus on quality, security and risk. The role may involve occasional travel to other Menzies offices for workshops, discovery sessions, implementation support and team meetings. Job Benefits Why Join Us? At Menzies, we know that success starts with our people. That’s why we offer: 🌍 Career Development : From learning opportunities to career coaching, we’ll help you achieve your goals. 🌍 Competitive Benefits : Private medical cover, pension matching, and enhanced parental leave, to name a few. 🌍 Flexibility That Works for You : Agile working is embedded in our culture. 🌍 Perks That Go Beyond : From volunteering days to wellbeing initiatives, we care about your whole self. To find out more about our benefits please read here

review_candidates.title: AI Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Location: Al Giza Mohandessin (on-site position) Fridays& Saturdays are off If you're interested, please send your CV and expected salary to: WhatsApp: 01006919331 Email: hr.mohammed@proleadersco.com The AI Data Engineer plays a pivotal role in building and operating the data infrastructure for the ProERP AI Agents Platform. This role is responsible for ensuring that data flows securely, with high quality, and in full compliance with regulations) from legacy systems (ERP, CRM, LMS) to the AI Agents. The focus is on building robust ETL pipelines, implementing strict PII Masking layers, and managing Vector Databases (PostgreSQL + pgvector) to power Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities. Qualifications / Requirements or Skills required Personal Traits - Skills - Academic requirements / Courses / License Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. Professional experience required Desired professional Experience Experience: 3 years of professional experience in Data Engineering. Proven 1–2+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Generative AI (GenAI) data pipelines, RAG architectures, or LLM data preparation. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience with Relational and Vector Databases (PostgreSQL, pgvector, or alternatives like Pinecone/Milvus). Advanced knowledge of Data Anonymization, Masking techniques, and data security best practices. Familiarity with Cloud Platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (e.g., Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, Secret Manager). Solid understanding of software engineering principles, version control (Git), and CI/CD pipeline automation. Prior experience working with OpenAI Agents SDK or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Other requirements Preferred Qualifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer).   Key Responsibilities: Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest structured (ERP, CRM, LMS) and unstructured data (documents, logs) into the AI environment. PII Masking & Anonymization: Design and enforce strict data masking and anonymization layers to strip or encrypt Personally Identifiable Information (PII) before it reaches any Large Language Model (LLM) or external API, adhering to the "Principle of Least Privilege". Vector Database Management: Manage, optimize, and scale Vector Databases (e.g., PostgreSQL with pgvector extension) to efficiently store and retrieve embeddings for RAG-powered AI Agents. Unified Customer Profile Development: Map and merge data schemas across disparate systems to build and maintain a "Unified Customer ID," ensuring accurate context and routing for AI Agents. Data Quality & Golden Datasets: Cleanse data, resolve discrepancies, and curate "Golden Datasets" used by AI Engineers and QA teams for LLM Evaluations, regression testing, and hallucination detection. Compliance & Data Governance: Implement and enforce data retention and deletion policies in strict alignment with SDAIA PDPL regulations. Ensure comprehensive Audit Logs (D11) for all data access and modifications. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Senior GenAI Engineer (to integrate RAG knowledge sources), Backend Engineers (for API integrations), and the Security/Compliance team to audit data vulnerabilities.

review_candidates.title: Marketing Analytics Intern
review_candidates.description: 📝 Marketing Analytics Intern (Unpaid) ⚠️ Applications will only be accepted through the following site: 👉 www.owlera.site About Owlera Owlera is an AI-powered career platform that helps students and fresh graduates gain practical experience through internship simulations inspired by real companies. Participants work on realistic business challenges, receive AI-powered feedback, use modern professional tools, and build portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their abilities to future employers. We're looking for curious, data-driven students to join our Marketing Analytics Internship and gain hands-on experience in the measurement and analysis work that turns marketing data into decisions. About the Internship As a Marketing Analytics Intern, you'll do realistic marketing analytics work inspired by real companies: tracking mock campaign performance, analyzing mock funnels, building mock dashboards, and running mock experiments. You'll learn how marketing analysts turn raw data into insight — measurement, attribution, experimentation, and reporting — that guides strategy and spend. Responsibilities * Track mock campaign performance across channels (paid, organic, email, social). * Analyze mock funnel metrics: impressions, clicks, conversions, and drop-off points. * Build mock marketing dashboards and KPI reports. * Write mock weekly/monthly performance summaries for stakeholders. * Run mock A/B and multivariate test analyses and document results. * Calculate mock CAC, LTV, ROAS, and other core marketing metrics. * Segment mock audiences and analyze behavior by cohort. * Draft mock attribution analyses across touchpoints. * Build mock pivot tables and data summaries from campaign exports. * Spot anomalies in mock performance data and draft hypotheses. * Draft mock experiment briefs with goals, hypotheses, and success metrics. * Analyze mock email and lifecycle performance (open, click, conversion). * Build mock competitor benchmarking tables for key metrics. * Document data definitions and measurement assumptions in a mock analytics glossary. * Prepare mock executive-ready presentations of findings and recommendations. * Use AI tools to clean data, draft analyses, and generate reporting ideas. Requirements * Current student or recent graduate in Marketing, Business, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. * Strong analytical mindset — you enjoy finding stories in numbers. * Comfortable working with spreadsheets; familiarity with basic SQL or BI tools is a plus but not required. * Clear written communication — you can explain findings to non-analysts. * Detail-oriented with strong organization and deadline habits. * Curiosity about marketing and how campaigns are measured. * Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms is a plus. * Previous professional analytics experience is not required. What You'll Gain * A portfolio of dashboards, analyses, and experiment reports. * Hands-on experience measuring mock marketing performance end to end. * Practical skills in funnels, attribution, and experimentation. * Understanding of how data drives marketing decisions. * Experience using AI for analysis and reporting. * Personalized AI feedback on your work. * Professional certificate upon successful completion. * Mentorship and weekly learning sessions. * Opportunity to strengthen your portfolio, resume, and interview readiness. Internship Details Role: Marketing Analytics Intern Location: Remote Type: Internship (Unpaid) Level: Entry Level Duration: 6 Weeks Commitment: Flexible (approximately 10–15 hours per week) If you're passionate about data, measurement, and the analytical work that makes marketing smarter, we'd love to hear from you. ⚠️ Apply through: 👉 www.owlera.site

You will help shape a new team and create the platforms that enable OCI engineers to deploy and operate services confidently at unprecedented scale. Designs, implements, and optimizes scalable, resilient, and highly available distributed systems . Leverages data-plane and distributed state technologies, builds fault-tolerant mechanisms, and develops performance and reliability testing. Proactively monitors and resolves production issues through telemetry, dashboards, incident response, and RCAs. Develops IaC and automation , implements security controls, and ensures operational, change-management, and compliance standards are met. Responsibilities Core responsibilities: System Design & Architecture Develop and optimize scalable distributed systems using distributed state-management and data-plane technologies. Implement scalability requirements and performance/load testing for large-scale workloads. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation. 11 paid holidays Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. To achieve this vision, Databricks is building the next generation (decoupled) query engine and structured storage system that can outperform specialized data warehouses in relational query performance. Yet we will retain the expressiveness and robustness of general purpose systems such as Apache Spark™ to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science. You will be part of this multi-year journey.
